sample.Description: Sample index of the event in the recording, starting at 0.

value.Description: Marker text as written by the experiment software.

trial_type.Description: Category of the event, derived from the marker text.

Levels.pre_meditation_begin: Start of the pre-up meditation block.
Levels.pre_meditation_end: End of the pre-up meditation block.
Levels.silent_emerge_begin: Start of the SILENT meditation block with spontaneous depth reports.
Levels.silent_emerge_end: End of the SILENT meditation block with spontaneous depth reports.
Levels.silent_probe_begin: Start of the SILENT meditation block with prompted depth reports.
Levels.silent_probe_end: End of the SILENT meditation block with prompted depth reports.
Levels.sapo_emerge_begin: Start of the SAPO meditation block with spontaneous depth reports.
Levels.sapo_emerge_end: End of the SAPO meditation block with spontaneous depth reports.
Levels.sapo_probe_begin: Start of the SAPO meditation block with prompted depth reports.
Levels.sapo_probe_end: End of the SAPO meditation block with prompted depth reports.
Levels.active_oddball_begin: Start of the active oddball task.
Levels.active_oddball_end: End of the active oddball task.
Levels.break_begin: Start of a break between blocks.
Levels.break_end: End of a break between blocks.
Levels.post_meditation_begin: Start of the cool-down meditation block.
Levels.post_meditation_end: End of the cool-down meditation block.
Levels.block_duration: Marker written at the end of a 35-minute block; the logged block duration is in the logged_duration column.
Levels.subblock_begin: Start of a sub-block within a meditation block.
Levels.subblock_end: End of a sub-block; the logged sub-block duration is in the logged_duration column.
Levels.silence_begin: Start of the part of a sub-block that precedes the gong.
Levels.silence_end: End of the part of a sub-block that precedes the gong.
Levels.gong_begin: Onset of the gong ending a sub-block, a cue to refocus attention.
Levels.report_window_begin: Start of a depth report initiated by the participant (emerge variant).
Levels.report_window_end: End of a depth report initiated by the participant.
Levels.prompt_window_begin: Start of a prompted depth report: probe variant, and the ratings after the pre-up meditation, active oddball and cool-down blocks.
Levels.prompt_window_end: End of a prompted depth report.
Levels.depth_rating: Depth rating registered; the rating is in the depth column.
Levels.confidence_rating: Confidence rating registered; the rating is in the confidence column.
Levels.clicker_press: Clicker press registered; the key is in the key column.
Levels.oddball_response: Button press in the active oddball task; the response time is in the response_time column.
Levels.boundary: Discontinuity in the data: a gap of more than 0.1 s in the EEG acquisition time stamps.

block.Description: Block in which the event occurred, or to which a report belongs.

Levels.baseline: Resting state with eyes closed, without meditation (5 min).
Levels.pre_meditation: Pre-up meditation in the participant's standard practice (5 min).
Levels.silent_emerge: Meditation without the SAPO sequence (SILENT), spontaneous depth reports (35 min).
Levels.silent_probe: Meditation without the SAPO sequence (SILENT), prompted depth reports (35 min).
Levels.sapo_emerge: Meditation with the sustained attention passive oddball sequence (SAPO), spontaneous depth reports (35 min).
Levels.sapo_probe: Meditation with the sustained attention passive oddball sequence (SAPO), prompted depth reports (35 min).
Levels.active_oddball: Active oddball task, button press to oddball tones (5 min).

depth.Description: Depth rating as registered, on the 1 to 5 scale. Values of 0 and above 5 occur in the recordings; the associated article removed ratings of 0 and set values above 5 to 5.

confidence.Description: Confidence rating as registered, on the 1 to 5 scale. Values of 0 and above 5 occur in the recordings.

response_time.Description: Response time in the active oddball task.

logged_duration.Description: Duration logged by the experiment software at the end of a sub-block or block.

key.Description: Clicker key registered by the experiment software.

hed_definitions.Description: HED definitions used by the annotations of this file.

HED.pre_meditation_block: (Definition/Pre-meditation-block, (Time-block, Eyes-closed, Description/Pre-up meditation in the standard practice of the participant))
HED.silent_emerge_block: (Definition/Silent-emerge-block, (Time-block, Eyes-closed, Description/Meditation without the oddball sequence with spontaneous depth reports))
HED.silent_probe_block: (Definition/Silent-probe-block, (Time-block, Eyes-closed, Description/Meditation without the oddball sequence with prompted depth reports))
HED.sapo_emerge_block: (Definition/SAPO-emerge-block, (Time-block, Eyes-closed, Description/Meditation with the passive oddball sequence and spontaneous depth reports))
HED.sapo_probe_block: (Definition/SAPO-probe-block, (Time-block, Eyes-closed, Description/Meditation with the passive oddball sequence and prompted depth reports))
HED.active_oddball_block: (Definition/Active-oddball-block, (Time-block, Eyes-closed, Description/Active auditory oddball task with a button press to oddball tones))
HED.report_window: (Definition/Report-window, (Time-block, Description/Depth and confidence report initiated by the participant))
